scope: Content hashes include untracked and ignored files under apps, packages, tests, scripts, docs and prototypes/d6, plus AGENTS.md, DECISIONS.md, package.json and tsconfig.json. Dependency trees, .git, .agents, .impeccable, run directories and native app dependency bundles are excluded. This is a bounded workspace audit, not a whole-machine or OS sandbox claim.
baselineNote: Earliest retained run snapshot; initial D6 test isolation edits already existed. Root Git modifications predated this work and were preserved. packages coverage was added later and is compared against the expanded snapshot.
limits: Previous-stage overwritten evidence has not been recovered.
Dependency symlinks are shared and not enforced read-only by the OS.
Snapshot coverage is bounded as listed, not an assertion that no other filesystem could be touched.
No visual baseline approval or production safety approval is granted.
